items.title: Israel kills senior member of Hamas's military wing in Gaza strike
items.description: The Israeli military said on Sunday its forces had killed a senior member of Hamas's military wing in Gaza. The militant group confirmed the death of Samir Abu Younis, the commander of its Rafah brigade, adding that he played a prominent role in planning the October 7, 2023 attacks.

items.title: Nadia Murad: ‘Day by day, I took my story back’
items.description: Nobel Peace Prize laureate Nadia Murad has spent years telling the world about the atrocities committed against her and the Yazidi community by militants from the terrorist group, ISIL.

items.title: Bahrain Says It Intercepted Iranian Attacks As Tehran Claims Strike On US Base
items.description: Bahrain said its air defenses intercepted and destroyed several Iranian aerial attacks on November 15, after explosions and air raid sirens were reported across the Gulf kingdom and Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps claimed it had targeted a US military installation.

items.title: Sudan: Misery worsens amid plummeting aid for displaced people
items.description: Sudan's humanitarian crisis is exacerbated by cuts in international aid. Almost 34 million people are in need as war and drone strikes are making it difficult to deliver aid to the population.
